scope: Monitoring unit and real PostgreSQL/ASGI integration checks, not physical fleet or production acceptance
coverage: Strict frozen configuration and fixture agreement
Separate identity, token rotation, connection CIDR and zero unauthorized DB access
No sensitive or unbounded URL labels/logs
Streaming backpressure, disconnects and exception propagation
Read-only independent PostgreSQL pool and bounded cached snapshots
Unique candidate/GPU accounting, unknown execution and invalid capacity
Future timestamps, missing duration samples and explicit unknowns
Offline exclusive-file CLI with explicit external configuration and safe error codes

retained_development_failures.case: Unit and integration module basename collision
retained_development_failures.resolution: Renamed integration module without changing import policy

retained_development_failures.case: Read-only test incorrectly required exactly one captured statement
retained_development_failures.resolution: Assert every captured transaction read-only observation is enabled
Wrap complete framework stack; verify final headers, body bytes and request ID

retained_development_failures.case: PromQL fixture omitted instance label for target-down alert
retained_development_failures.resolution: Preserve target-specific instance expectation; production rule unchanged
